description: Check whether this channel's WhatsApp number is eligible for a Meta Business Agent. Returns {is_eligible: boolean}. Known limitation: a 403 from this call can mean the number is simply not eligible, rather than that the business has not accepted Meta's terms - do not report an unaccepted-terms problem on a 403 alone.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_check_agent_eligibility
title: Check agent eligibility
